title: bot.ability.hearing.speech.stream.audio
description: A sound heard, streamed to the session: by reference, as environment.sound carries it [floppy: audio by reference, where mosfet.py's AudioData carries the PCM].

audio.description: Reference (a URI reference) to the sound's audio: a WAV file, or raw signed 16-bit PCM at sample_rate_hz and channels [floppy field].
audio.title: Audio

media_type.description: Optional media type of the audio.
media_type.title: Media Type

sample_rate_hz.description: Sample rate of raw audio in hertz.
sample_rate_hz.title: Sample Rate Hz

output.description: Optional reference (a URI reference) the 16 kHz mono signed 16-bit PCM sent is also written to, so the invoking session keeps its sounds in one format [floppy field].
output.title: Output
